paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, comprising a total of thirteen distinct slices. Moving clockwise from the top right, the categories and their respective proportions are as follows: NQ in blue (31.3%), SCIFACT as a tiny dark sliver (0.1%), ENTFA in yellow (1.8%), FACTCC in green (2.6%), ANLI in dark orange (4.6%), FEVER in teal (16.1%), MULTIFC as a very thin blue sliver (0.5%), MULTINLI in coral pink (11.3%), PUBHEALTH as a tiny yellow sliver (0.5%), SCITAIL in light green (1.2%), SNLI in light orange (15.4%), VITAMINC in cyan (13.0%), and XSUMHUL in pale lavender (1.6%). The chart does not utilize a separate legend or contain percentage labels inside the slices; instead, all category labels and their corresponding percentages are positioned outside the pie and connected to their specific segments using thin gray leader lines. There are no exploded, offset, or visually emphasized slices, and the segments do not appear to be arranged in any specific ascending or descending order based on their size.
